accepted.quote: Ways and Means Democrats strongly support bringing to justice the criminals who stole from our unemployment system during the pandemic.
accepted.rationale: Neal expresses strong support for prosecuting pandemic unemployment fraud.

accepted.quote: We regret that we are unable to support H.R. 1156.
accepted.rationale: Neal states clear opposition to the pandemic UI fraud statute-of-limitations bill.

accepted.quote: We also opposed Republican cuts to the Office of the Inspector General (OIG) budget that forced it to lay off staff and slow its work, which increased the number of cases at risk of not being completed before they reached the statute of limitations.
accepted.rationale: Neal opposes cuts to the Labor OIG budget and supports maintaining its fraud-fighting funding and staffing.
